description: The bar chart illustrates a comparative breakdown of three components—“Context,” “Generated Response,” and “Other”—across two methods: “Ours” and “Standard,” as evaluated in the paper “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision.” The horizontal axis represents the percentage contribution of each component, while the vertical axis lists the two methods. For “Ours,” the blue “Context” segment accounts for 60.6%, the orange “Generated Response” segment is 32.7% (calculated as 100% – 60.6% – 7.7%), and the green “Other” segment is 7.7%. For “Standard,” the blue “Context” segment is 23.6%, the orange “Generated Response” segment is 51.1%, and the green “Other” segment is 25.3%. The chart uses a stacked horizontal bar format, with each bar divided into colored segments corresponding to the legend at the bottom. The “Ours” method shows a significantly higher proportion of “Context” and lower “Other” compared to “Standard,” while “Generated Response” is more dominant in the “Standard” method. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in method order, with no additional annotations or emphasis beyond the percentage labels within each segment.
